strategies.name: Strategy 1: Signed loop with early exit
strategies.rationale: The patch only adds unsigned comparison facts (ICMP_ULE) to exit blocks, but should add both signed (ICMP_SLE) and unsigned facts like the existing code does for loop latch blocks. This can cause missed optimizations for signed comparisons in exit blocks.
strategies.expected_issue: Missing optimization for signed comparisons in loop exit blocks when induction variable and bound are signed integers.

strategies.name: Strategy 2: Negative start value with signed bound
strategies.rationale: When loop has negative start value and signed bound, the patch uses unsigned precondition (StartValue <= B unsigned) which may be false even when signed precondition (StartValue <= B signed) is true. This prevents adding any facts to exit blocks, missing potential optimizations.
strategies.expected_issue: No facts added to exit blocks for signed loops with negative start values, even when signed facts could be added.

strategies.name: Strategy 3: Mixed signed/unsigned comparisons
strategies.rationale: If exit block contains both signed and unsigned comparisons, the patch only provides unsigned facts, potentially missing optimizations for signed comparisons.
strategies.expected_issue: Suboptimal optimization in exit blocks with mixed signed/unsigned comparisons.
